query: Please implement a database visualization website for connecting to and managing databases. The website should have functionalities for connecting to databases, monitoring computer performance, and directly performing CRUD (create, read, update, delete) operations on databases. Users should be able to log in, connect to different databases, monitor computer performance, browse and manage data within databases, and perform CRUD operations. Style the layout with mint cream in the background and dark green for the interface.
